company.shortDescription: Dubai Islamic Bank is a provider of financial products and services.
company.description:
Dubai Islamic Bank is a provider of financial products and services.

It offers corporate, as well as, personal, SME, and priority banking services and gives its users access to conventional cash management, online payments, business financing, and saving services. The company also operates wealth management, financing, investment banking, treasury product, and capital market division.

The Dubai, Dubai-based company was formed by Haj Saeed Bin Ahmed Al Lootah in 1975.
